fact: The US International Trade Administration reports Ethiopia's e-GP system, piloted since 2021, was expanded in 2023 to 74 federal agencies, and registered suppliers can submit bids online.
The US International Trade Administration, citing the PPPA, reports over 1,200 procurement opportunities posted on the e-GP in the past year and nearly 8,000 registered suppliers.
The Federal Public Procurement and Property Authority said the electronic procurement system was implemented across 169 federal budgetary institutions and 93 branch offices in EFY 2017.

The Authority said 308.75 billion Birr of procurement went through the electronic system in EFY 2017 (300 billion by bidding, 8.75 billion by price quotation), after 65 percent of procurement in 2016.
Addis Fortune reports the Public Procurement & Property Authority piloted electronic government procurement with nine federal agencies and made it compulsory for 72 agencies in August 2022.

Addis Fortune reports the Authority is automating the end-to-end process, with procurement plans, tendering, bid evaluations and award notices communicated through the portal, compulsory for 72 of 174 federal agencies.
Addis Fortune reports no more than 2,200 suppliers are listed on the e-procurement system against 50,000 on the manual federal scheme.
